      public int rating() throws NeoFlixException
      Returns the calculated rating of the series.
      Specified by:
      rating in class Content
      Returns:
      the average rating of its episodes
      Throws:
      NeoFlixException - CONTENT_EMPTY if the series has no episodes, VALUE_UNKNOWN if the rating for any episode is unknown, DATA_ERROR if the rating for any episode cannot be calculated due to a data error

    • rating

      public int rating(int default_) throws NeoFlixException
      Returns the calculated rating, using the default value for episodes with an unknown rating and ignoring those with errors.
      Parameters:
      default_ - the default rating to use for episodes with an unknown rating
      Returns:
      the calculated average rating
      Throws:
      NeoFlixException - UNKNOWN_VALUE if the rating cannot be calculated

    • rating

      public int rating(boolean previous) throws NeoFlixException
      Returns the calculated rating, replacing unknown episode ratings with the average of previous episodes or the average of all valid episodes, depending on the previous parameter.
      Parameters:
      previous - true to use the average of previous episodes, false to use the global average
      Returns:
      the calculated average rating
      Throws:
      NeoFlixException - CONTENT_EMPTY if the series has no episodes, VALUE_UNKNOWN if the rating cannot be calculated DATA_ERROR if any episode has a inconsistent data

    • popularity

      public int popularity() throws NeoFlixException
      Returns the calculated popularity of the series as the average of its valid episodes. Episodes with unknown popularity are ignored, and episodes with data errors are propagated.
      Specified by:
      popularity in class Content
      Returns:
      the average popularity in [0..100]
      Throws:
      NeoFlixException - CONTENT_EMPTY if the series has no episodes, VALUE_UNKNOWN if no episode has a computable popularity, DATA_ERROR if any episode has invalid popularity data
